name: hooks
usage: Each hook is two groups in <defs>: <id>-back and <id>-front, drawn with the origin at the upper (left) anchor hole centre. Place both with the same translate(hole_x, hole_y): back, then the hung object, then front. Back alone plus front alone is the empty hook.

projection.means: a point at depth z px in front of the board is drawn at (x + a*z, y + b*z); depth reads as down-right

light: upper left, 10 o'clock; no cast shadow drawn (scripts/compose-banner.py adds it)

anchors.role: bend seated in the hole below; prong root

hang.means: top surface of the prong where the object rests: put the inside top edge of the hang hole (or loop) here; a round hole of radius r is centred at (x, y + r)
top of the two prongs where the loop rests (the loop spans both wires): put the inside top of the backpack's grab loop here
where the bottle stands: its centre line at x, the bottom of its glass on the shelf's top surface at y

anchors.role: left back wire, stub seated in hole behind it
right back wire, stub seated in hole behind it

hang.means: where the book stands: its centre line at x, the bottom edge of its front face at y. The book stands upright on the tray (top surface y 120 at the board), back against the back wires at depth 8 px, front face at depth 60 px, so the front bottom edge is drawn at (154 + 0.15*60, 120 + 0.25*60)

real_size_cm.hook-heavy: 5.4 mm wire, two parallel 12.1 cm prongs 20 px apart
real_size_cm.shelf: sheet shelf 11.0 x 8.9 cm, 6 mm front lip, two 4.5 mm wire brackets
real_size_cm.pocket: wire literature pocket 17.8 cm wide (17.3 cm inside), 4.0 cm deep tray, front rails 7.0 cm high, 4.5 mm wire; back tabs 7 pitches apart

traced_from: US 4,750,700 Fig. 3 (United States patent drawing, https://patents.google.com/patent/US4750700A): side profile, bend radii, 5.0 deg prong droop, 35.9 deg upturn
